lines: The café is having a little nap. Shhh, chairs.
All the café chairs are empty. Which one would Léo pick?
Marcel is wiping a table that is already clean. Extra clean.
Only one man at the café. He has the whole sun to himself.
The parasols are still open but nobody is under them. Silly.
The café is so quiet I can hear the spoon. Tink.
Bonjour, {name}! Have you seen a fast boy? Check your pockets.
{name} walked past and did not step on one crack. Good walking.
{name}! If you see my friend, say I went this way. Then that way.
I waved at {name}. {name} waved back. That makes two waves.
{name} went by. I said bonjour in my most grown-up voice.
Mind out, {name}! This is the racing bit!
Lucie is faster than Léo. Wheels count. I checked the rules.
Lucie went whoosh. My hair went whoosh too. A bit late.
When I am big I will have a bike with a basket for Léo.
Inès ran past! I ran next to her for three steps. Team!
Inès has springs in her shoes. I asked. She just laughed.
Inès said allez, allez! So I allez-ed. Quite far.
Léo! That was me you just passed! Again!
Léo went past so fast my hat lifted up to see.
There goes Léo. Here goes me. A little bit after.
Léo lapped me. So really I lapped him, backwards.
Henri and Odile walk arm in arm. Like a little train for two.
Bonjour, Henri! Bonjour, Odile! Bonjour, cane!
Henri and Odile walk slowly so the sun can keep up.
Asgeir has a baguette! It is longer than my whole arm!
Hei, Asgeir! That is hello in Norway. He taught me.
Ding! That is Lucie's bell. I would know it anywhere.
Ding ding! I said ding back. We are having a talk.
The bell! Léo says it means the next lap starts now.
Gull! I heard you! I am down here! The one waving!
The gull laughed. Léo says gulls laugh at his jokes.
That gull is calling its friends. Léo calls me like that.
A gull shouted, so I shouted. Caw! Now we are even.
A gull called. Léo says that means half time. Snack time!
There is a coin in the fountain with a star on it. Léo saw it.
Put your ear by the fountain. It sounds like clapping. For us.
The pigeons sit on the edge to watch us race. Front row.
I made a wish in the fountain. It was about Léo going slower.
The fountain splashed my knee. Now I have a wet knee. Good.
Back at the fountain. It kept our spot for us.
I spun the postcard stand once. Only once. That is the rule.
Newspapers at the kiosk. I can read le, la and soleil.
The kiosk smells like coffee and paper. A grown-up smell.
If I had a kiosk, I would sell pebbles. Only the smooth ones.
The post office sign is glowing. A robot is writing a letter.
I put my ear on the post office wall. It hums. Robots typing.
Do robots lick stamps? Léo says they lick the screen.
The post office does not even have a lunch break. Brave.
Bonjour, robots! I hope your emails are nice today.
At the arcade Léo made a story where a cat drives a bus.
I made a Fun Libs story. The hero was a pebble. He won.
Someone in the arcade laughed so loud. Good story, I think.
I peeked in the arcade for Léo. Only silly stories. Nice ones.
The workshop light is on. Someone is building with no hammer.
I peeked in the workshop. Lots of screens. No sawdust at all.
Toolrails is being built. I am building a sandcastle. Same job.
The workshop is very quiet. Computer tools must be quiet tools.
One lamp is on in the library. It is reading all by itself.
When the library opens again, I will read every dragon book.
I put my nose on the library window. Books. All napping.
Inès runs every evening. She must be extremely good at it.
Inès is doing laps. So am I. Inside my head.
Marcel carries the tray with one hand. I tried with a book.
Marcel winked at me with a whole tray on his hand. Wow.
Henri is doing the crossword. I know one. Sun. Three letters.
Henri reads the paper with his eyebrows. They go up and down.
Henri walks with his cane. Tap, step, tap. Like music.
Odile waved at me from the bench. I did a little bow back.
Odile is telling Henri a story. He keeps nodding. A long one.
Léo is ahead of me. That is where Léo always goes.
Léo is counting coins in the fountain. He is up to lots.
Léo is practising the spinny bit. He is very dizzy. Bravo!
Léo's mama is looking for Léo too. We can look together!
Camille is on the phone. She says Léo's name a lot.
Camille gave me the look that means walk, do not run. Walking.
Théo is walking in a nice slow way. He is good at slow.
Théo is on his phone. He says he is working. He is smiling.
The builder is at the arcade, smiling at his phone.
Asgeir is asking Henri about the lemons. Very serious talk.
Asgeir holds his kiosk coffee with two hands. Like cocoa.
Asgeir is doing his thinking walk. It goes slow.
Lucie is having coffee at the kiosk. Her bike waits nicely.
Lucie is cycling round with a basket full of errands.
exchanges: Léo! How many laps is that?
Eleven! You are on ten. Nearly!
Marcel, can I carry the tray one day?
When you are taller than the tray, oui.
Hei hei! Your Norwegian is getting good.
Very. Ask me again when you are twelve.
Camille, I am looking for Léo too!
Then we are a search party. Merci.
A story someone just made. A goat in a tuxedo.
